text:
sara.chen: Heads-up — int4 canary for rwd-v6 at 12% is showing a regression on the long-doc summarization slice. Need quick call on whether to pause/attenuate/rollback.

mike: Which metrics are we gating on? long_doc_rouge-L, hallucination-rate, latency p95?

sara.chen: Primary = long_doc_rouge-L (we set delta_threshold -6%), secondary: hallucination_rate, prefix_cache_hit. Canary config:
```yaml
canary:
  frac: 0.12
  metrics:
    - name: long_doc_rouge-L
      delta_threshold: -0.06
      sample_size: 1200
  attenuation:
    type: step
    steps: [0.12, 0.06, 0.02]
    trigger: rolling_window_30m
hysteresis: 0.10
min_hold_time: 7200
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started rwd-v6-int4 @ pods=20; initial smoke OK. p50=60ms p95=180ms.

priya: Focused eval on long-docs shows ~6.8% ROUGE-L drop vs baseline across the sampled set. Codegen slice hallucination ticked up slightly (low absolute). Recommend auto-fallback threshold at -5% and attenuate to 6% while we run deeper checks + shadow int8.

mike: -5% sounds reasonable. Also propose: add EWMA smoothing (alpha=0.2), require failing_count >= 500 to trigger, set min_hold_time=2h, and backoff multiplier 0.5 for step attenuation to avoid oscillation.

sara.chen: Noted. Also seeing prefix_cache_hit ~0.12 during the failing window — suspect kv-cache alignment issue with int4. Add cache_hit as a secondary gating signal.

vik: Action items: priya -> run 1,200 long-doc eval + 800 codegen priority slices (post confusion matrix). mike -> update attenuation config with hold/backoff/ewma/fail_count. sara -> reduce live frac -> 6% hold until eval lands. If delta stays <= -5% for 30m EWMA -> rollback.

priya: Running focused eval now on q3 cluster. ETA ~40m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Attenuation applied: frac -> 0.06 at 1745604328. Observability: https://console.redwood.ai/models/rwd-v6/canary/charts

priya: Early eval results: 640 failing examples per our definition, avg delta -6.5% ROUGE-L, failure distribution concentrated on docs > 6k tokens and low cache_hit samples. Uploading sample ids to S3.

sara.chen: That crosses the failing_count threshold. Per the new gate: if EWMA remains below -5% for next 30m -> automatic rollback. Initiate rollback if it doesn't recover.

vik: I'll update the runbook to include failing_count + EWMA + min_hold_time gates and tag this release 'attenuation-tested'. Record cache_hit correlation for postmortem hypotheses.

mike: I'll open a short ticket for hybrid fallback (int8 for long-docs, int4 for short) + kv-cache alignment experiments.

sara.chen: Rolling back to int8 baseline per policy. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
